name: 破晓星环旗舰
orientation: flat horizontal annulus with left-facing command spear; rear engines right
visual_review: Usable: flat annular flagship layout, long left spear, four radial armored connections and four large negative-space quadrants; transparency verified in all four holes. Three rear engine banks clearly visible, fourth not verified. Full uncut body, horizontal margins 2.2-2.9 percent rather than requested 8 percent. Retained one native generation.
